STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_10429_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_10429_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_10429 (
    E_src1,
    E_src2,
    M_en,
    clk,
    reset_n,
    M_mul_cell_p1,
    M_mul_cell_p2,
    M_mul_cell_p3
);

  output  [31:0] M_mul_cell_p1;
  output  [31:0] M_mul_cell_p2;
  output  [31:0] M_mul_cell_p3;
  input   [31:0] E_src1;
  input   [31:0] E_src2;
  input          M_en;
  input          clk;
  input          reset_n;

  wire    [31:0] M_mul_cell_p1;
  wire    [31:0] M_mul_cell_p2;
  wire    [31:0] M_mul_cell_p3;
  wire           mul_clr;
  wire    [31:0] mul_src1;
  wire    [31:0] mul_src2;

  assign mul_clr = ~reset_n;
  assign mul_src1 = E_src1;
  assign mul_src2 = E_src2;

  assign M_mul_cell_p1 = (mul_src1[15:0] * mul_src2[15:0]);
  assign M_mul_cell_p2 = (mul_src1[15:0] * mul_src2[31:16]);
  assign M_mul_cell_p3 = (mul_src1[31:16] * mul_src2[15:0]);

endmodule
